comment: Official cybercore.* packs. tools/export-distribution.py packs builds each one from the sources named in its payload function and writes it to cybercore-packs. 'version' is the floor: an unchanged payload keeps its published version, a changed one gets the next patch version.

packs.title: Cybercore Themes
packs.description: Every CYBERGRID theme (600 palettes in 50 families) as one catalog, plus the 12 signature mashups and the classic terminal palettes they use. Source: schema/themes, schema/mashups.json, schema/kitty-themes.json.

packs.title: Cybercore Effects
packs.description: Web Kit effect styles and recipes (scanline, grid glow, telemetry pulse) with motion profiles, plus standalone effects such as the HUD scanline with static and reduced-motion fallbacks.

packs.title: Cybercore Components
packs.description: Design tokens, the shared component stylesheet (buttons, cards, navigation, alerts, forms, focus) and the universal theme chooser element.

packs.title: CyberDark Wallpapers
packs.description: 4K SVG desktop wallpapers with an index and the theme-to-wallpaper assignments from cybergrid.json.

packs.title: Cybercore Snippets
packs.description: Copy-ready snippets: theme chooser embed, site variable mapping, Web Kit runtime, themed CSS, Rust theme loading and status publishing, CI theme checks and pack installs.

packs.title: Cybercore Fonts
packs.description: Self-hosted OFL fonts used across Cybercore (Oxanium, Orbitron, Audiowide, Share Tech Mono) with licenses and a ready @font-face stylesheet.

packs.title: Cybercore SVG Assets
packs.description: Cybercore logos, wordmarks, headers, social card, divider and the app icon at every size, with an index of titles.

packs.title: Cybercore Web Templates
packs.description: Dependency-free HTML page templates wired to the live Cybercore kit and theme chooser.
